ev_A.fact: For a vaccine excursion, I aligned logger downloads, door records, and carrier scans before recommending testing; the batch passed after the actual warm interval was isolated.

ev_B.fact: On a rapid distribution call, I advised destruction from a single high sensor reading; later data showed the logger sat by an open loading door, and usable doses had been discarded.

E1.fact: A hospital chain wants a disposition during its urgent procurement call because replacement doses must be ordered before noon.

E2.fact: The carrier can send synchronized logger and door records before the hospital call, but only if the shipment is flagged the prior evening.
